opportunities.description:
About Radiant

Radiant is an El Segundo, CA-based startup building the worldâs first mass-produced, portable nuclear microreactors. The companyâs first reactor, Kaleidos, is a 1-megawatt, fail-safe microreactor that can be transported anywhere power is needed and run for up to 5 years without refueling. Portable nuclear power with rapid-deploy capability can replace similar-sized diesel generators and provide critical asset support for hospitals, data centers, remote sites, and military bases. Radiantâs unique, practical approach to nuclear development leverages modern software engineering to rapidly deliver safe, factory-built microreactors that use existing, well-qualified materials. Founded in 2020, Radiant is on track to test its first reactor at the Idaho National Laboratory this summer, with initial customer deliveries beginning in 2028.

About the Role

Radiant is seeking a driven recent grad to join our talent team and help build the engineering teams behind Kaleidos, our portable, mass-producible nuclear microreactor targeting commercial deployment in 2028. This is a role for someone who wants to start a career in recruitment, work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment with real ownership and influence, build a deep tech career, and learn about several technical domains like nuclear, hardware, electrical, software, and more. You'll get close mentorship from recruiters and sourcers who've built teams before, regular visibility with executives, own requisitions, and find top talent for engineering leaders and their teams.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Run your own reqs from open to close, building the pipeline, screening candidates, coordinating interviews, and getting offers signed.

  • Find niche talent markets for specialized engineering roles in places like GitHub repos, arXiv papers, technical mailing lists, tech foundation communities, conference speaker rosters, and academic programs.

  • Create talent market reports based on research you drive to help make better-informed recruiting strategies.

  • Coordinate interviews and help facilitate hiring team debriefs to keep decisions moving quickly.

  • Sit in on offer conversations with senior recruiters and learn how strategy and closing work in practice.

  • Help shape how Radiant recruits; the processes, tools, and 3rd party platforms you help build and adopt now become the foundation the team scales on.

  • Get hands-on exposure to hiring across multiple technical functions: electrical, mechanical, software, and more.

Required Qualifications and Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited university.

  • 0â2 years of experience in recruiting, sales, sourcing, or coordination, or you've picked it up on your own and can point to something that proves it.

  • Something outside the classroom that shows real team influence, a club you led, student government, a project you built, a sport you competed in, or work you volunteered for.

  • A genuine pull toward hardware, nuclear, physics, or AI/ML; you don't need an engineering background, just real curiosity.

  • A bias toward action: you move quickly, problem-solve on the fly, and know when to raise your hand for help.

  • You're able to hold a genuine conversation with technical candidates, curious enough to ask good questions, and honest enough to admit when something's outside your depth.

Desired Qualifications and Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in a STEM-related major is a plus.

  • Any prior exposure to hardware, software, engineering, or tech recruiting, even informally.

  • Comfort picking up new tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter, ATS, sourcing, LLM platforms, even without direct prior experience.

Additional Requirements:

  • Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as necessary to accomplish our mission.

  • Must work 100% onsite at El Segundo HQ.

Benefits and Perks

  • Stock: Substantial incentive stock plan for all full-time employees.

  • Medical: 100% up to base silver level plan for employee + 50% dependents, offers up to Platinum plans.

  • One Medical: Sponsored memberships for employees and their dependents.

  • Vision: 100% top tier plan coverage + 50% for dependents.

  • Dental: 100% top tier plan coverage, orthodontia extra, 50% for dependents.

  • Voluntary life, accident, hospital, critical illness, commuter and FSA/HSA are offered as employee contributed benefits.

  • 8-weeks of paid parental leave for all parents. Additional paid pregnancy leave for CA employees.

  • Daily catered lunch. Free snacks and drinks.

  • Flexible PTO policy. Remote workday allocation.

  • Company and team-bonding events, happy hours and in-person camaraderie.

  • Beautiful El Segundo headquarters close to the Pacific Ocean.

Total Compensation and Benefits
Radiant compensates people for impact and invests in those who continue to raise the bar. Radiantâs new hire compensation package includes base salary, substantial equity grants, and comprehensive health benefits. Total compensation and level are determined through a rigorous evaluation of interview performance, experience, education, and qualifications, and are designed to support continued growth as scope, responsibility, and impact expand at Radiant.

The best of todayâs advanced reactor builders donât wait for job postings. They join the winning team. If thatâs you, contact us directly for immediate opportunities: recruiting@radiantnuclear.com.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

This position involves access to technology that is subject to U.S. export controls. Any job offer made will be contingent upon the applicantâs capacity to serve in compliance with U.S. export controls.

opportunities.title: Brand Designer
opportunities.description:
About Co-Star

Someone downloads CoâStar every 5 seconds.

In the five years since we launched, 25% of young people 18-25 in the US have downloaded the app. Big Sean has rapped about us, Ariana Grande & Kevin Durant post screenshots to their IGs, and we've been App of the Day twice. We've been featured in the New York Times three times, this year on the cover of NYT Style. We have a global following, in 193 countries â missing just North Korea and Eritrea.

We don't pay for marketing â we designed the app to go viral, and it did.

Astrology has been popular for 4,000 years.

Astrology is a tool for speaking about yourself, about who you are, what you're experiencing, and how you relate to other people â in other words, a language for the things that really matter. It's a structured system, based on the physical locations of the planets in the sky, developed over millennia 4,000 years of practice.

Everyone has memories of reading a horoscope in the newspaper. You know your sign the same way you know the name of the street you grew up on. An average of 43% of Americans have believed in astrology since the 1970s.

We're merging the resonance of the humanities with the precision of technology.

Co-Star uses real-time NASA data and AI to bring this practice to the modern age. Every day, CoâStar generates millions of hyper-personalized horoscopes â a scale never previously possible. Every word of it is based on each person's unique astrology: where the stars physically were when they were born and where those same stars are now. CoâStar combines the art of ancient practice with cutting-edge artificial intelligence, creating the first synthetic text to be called "wildly beautiful."

We're a small, experienced team.

Co-Star is a team of 30, with experience in big tech (Amazon, Google, Snapchat), entertainment (Frank Ocean, Adult Swim), and academia (Harvard, Stanford, NYU, Columbia).

About The Brand Designer Role

We're looking for a talented visual designer to shape how Co-Star shows up outside of the app, in the broader world. We are looking for someone with a fresh, opinionated, and high-quality design foundation who can create work that feels distinct, not what's now but what's next.

You'll partner closely with the leadership on campaigns and visual storytelling across earned and owned channels. This is a freelance engagement with potential for a long-term partnership as the work (and team) grows.

What you'll do

  • Design campaign visuals: ads, social, launches â from concept through finished assets
  • Bring editorial design sensibility to our owned channels: email/welcome series, blog, campaign imagery
  • Develop visual systems that are expressive rather than corporate
  • Partner with marketing on what earned and owned should look and feel like
  • Collaborate async with a small, fast-moving team

You might be a fit if

  • You're a senior IC â roughly 5â8 years in â with a portfolio of expressive, culturally fluent graphic design: editorial, campaigns, identities across print and digital
  • Typography and composition are your first language
  • You can direct as well as execute: you've shaped campaigns, not just produced assets for them
  • You're plugged into visual culture across art, fashion, publishing, music, and the internet
  • You work well remotely and independently

Nice to have

  • Editorial/publication experience (print or digital magazines)
  • Motion or illustration
  • You already make things with generative tools

Logistics

  • Freelance/contract, part-time to start, with room to grow
  • Fully remote, anywhere. No travel required (though you're always welcome in NYC)

To apply

Send your portfolio. We care about taste, range, and point of view.

opportunities.title: VP of Strategic Partnerships & Growth
opportunities.description:
About HealthCorps

HealthCorps is a national non-profit committed to improving lives by addressing health challenges in communities through innovative programming in education, leadership, and service learning. We empower teens to become change agents within their families, schools, and neighborhoods. Our program is grounded in the understanding that limited access to health education can lead to a lifetime of social, emotional, and physical challenges.

The Opportunity

HealthCorps is launching a new Growth & Strategic Partnerships Division, and the VP of Strategic Partnerships & Growth will be its architect, engine, and external face. You'll hold a broad, high-impact portfolio: leading HealthCorps' national funder and strategic partnerships, driving development, grant management, and fundraising, shaping our brand and marketing, and growing our alumni, community, and hub partnership work. You won't do it alone. A national team, along with program managers across our hubs, will help you build and execute this vision.

Reporting directly to the CEO, you will hold your own portfolio of partnerships, work closely with leadership to develop and execute strategies that meet HealthCorps' revenue and growth goals, and represent HealthCorps externally at donor meetings, funder convenings, and sector events. This is an ideal role for a mission-aligned leader who can prospect a health system executive and coach a marketing manager in the same week, someone energized by both the hunt and the build.

For-profit and private sector backgrounds are strongly welcomed. If you have driven revenue, built partnerships, and told a compelling brand story, in any sector, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Do

External Relationship Strategy, Cultivation & Maintenance (30%)

  • Serve as a key external relationship officer alongside the CEO, cultivating and stewarding relationships across health systems, corporate sponsors, school districts, foundations, and community organizations
  • Design and lead a comprehensive partnership strategy spanning grant, sponsor, and programmatic relationships that aligns funder priorities with organizational growth goals
  • Build and manage a robust pipeline of new and emerging partnership opportunities, cultivating prospects from first touch through qualification
  • Steward existing partners to deepen loyalty, increase lifetime value, and drive renewals and upgrades
  • Track funding trends and shifting funder priorities to position HealthCorps ahead of major market shifts

Pitching, Proposals & Partner Stewardship (25%)

  • Own the full partnership sales cycle for mid-tier and emerging opportunities, from first outreach through close and activation
  • Develop pitches, proposals, and grant applications that translate HealthCorps' outcomes data into a compelling, fundable case for support
  • Partner with the CEO and leadership to identify, solicit, and close transformational sponsorships for the major annual fundraiser and national and hub-level programming
  • Demonstrate ongoing value to existing partners through exceptional stewardship that keeps them connected to our mission and measurable impact

Brand Strategy & Voice (20%)

  • Set strategic tone and direction for the HealthCorps brand across all external-facing channels and oversee the Marketing Manager in executing it across social media, website, newsletters, and press
  • Lead the design and execution of a brand and communications strategy that builds awareness and trust across funders, partners, and the broader public
  • Partner with program teams to translate research-validated impact data and stories into compelling, consistent external narratives
  • Develop partner-facing collateral â partnership decks, impact reports, and stakeholder communications â that reflect the quality of the organization
  • Represent HealthCorps at conferences, sector events, and media opportunities alongside the CEO and program leaders

Hub, Community & Alumni Partnerships (15%)

  • Build local advisory committees that connect HealthCorps to local civic, education, and philanthropic leaders, in partnership with the Alumni & Community Manager and Program Directors
  • Strengthen HealthCorps' presence in each market by partnering with local teams to plan events, cultivate partnerships, and raise the organization's visibility
  • Cultivate and engage HealthCorps' alumni as a strategic community, building a strong, active network and connecting alumni to advisory roles, volunteer opportunities, and local partnerships that extend our reach

Division Leadership & Team Management (10%)

  • Lead and develop a high-performing team: Senior Manager of Development, Marketing Manager, Director of Events (part-time), and Alumni & Community Manager
  • Serve as a player-coach who models the work while developing others, holding your own partnership portfolio while coaching the team toward revenue and relationship goals
  • Establish and monitor division KPIs across pipeline, revenue, and brand performance, reporting to the CEO and Board to ensure measurable ROI
  • Manage the division budget and contribute to organization-wide strategic planning as a member of the leadership team

Who You Are

You are a relationship-builder, a closer, and a brand thinker. The ideal candidate brings:

  • 7+years of experience in strategic partnerships, business development, sales, or revenue-generating roles, with a demonstrated track record of closing and stewarding high-value relationships. Nonprofit, for-profit, and private sector backgrounds are all strongly welcomed
  • Experience holding your own portfolio while leading and developing a team; you are a player-coach who can model the work and develop others simultaneously
  • Proven pitching and presentation skills; you are comfortable in a boardroom, at a funder meeting, and in a pitch meeting, and you know how to read a room and close
  • Experience setting brand direction and overseeing marketing or communications functions, with the ability to translate complex program outcomes into compelling external narratives
  • Strong written communication skills: from partner proposals to grant narratives to impact reports, your writing moves people to act
  • Familiarity with health systems, corporate social responsibility, education, or youth-serving sectors; experience working with health systems or school districts is a strong plus
  • Comfort building and operating in an entrepreneurial, fast-growth environment where you may be creating systems and structures from scratch
  • Proficiency with CRM platforms and a data-driven approach to pipeline management and relationship tracking. And a data-driven approach to pipeline management and relationship tracking
  • A genuine belief in the power of near-peer mentorship and a passion for health equity and youth development

Requirements

Qualifications

Required

Bachelor's degree in business, public health, communications, marketing, or a related field.

  • 7+ years of relevant professional experience in business development, strategic partnerships, sales, or revenue leadership in any sector.
  • Experience managing direct reports and leading cross-functional teams
  • Demonstrated success closing and growing partnerships, accounts, or revenue relationships and managing a portfolio of accounts
  • Travel to HealthCorps hubs, partner sites, and sector events will be required

Preferred

  • Experience in healthcare, health systems, corporate social responsibility, or youth-serving organizations, nonprofit or for-profit
  • Track record of building revenue through client, sponsor, or partner relationships; experience with philanthropic fundraising is a plus but not required
  • Experience building advisory boards, local steering committees, or community engagement structures
  • Experience translating a commercial sales or business development skillset into a mission-driven environment
  • Master's degree or equivalent advanced training

Compensation & Benefits

This is a full time, exempt position, and you will be offered a comprehensive benefits package. Yearly compensation for the role depends on a number of factors, including candidates' qualifications, skills, competencies, experience, and location.

Because we operate across multiple states, compensation is aligned with applicable federal, state, and local requirements, including salary thresholds where applicable. Slight preference given to the candidate that live in one of our hub areas: Pittsburgh, PA, Philadelphia, PA, Cleveland, OH, Oklahoma City, OK, South Florida (Palm Beach/Miami), Houston, TX and Phoenix, AZ.

At HealthCorps, we believe our team members are our greatest asset. That's why full-time employees enjoy comprehensive benefits packages designed to support your health, financial security, and overall, well-being. Our offerings include

  • Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) to relax, recharge, and take care of what matters most
  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance to keep you and your family healthy
  • Life Insurance coverage for added piece of mind
  • A 401(k) with company match to help you plan for the future
  • Additional ancillary benefits tailored to fit your lifestyle and needs

Plus, HealthCorps proudly recognizes and observes most federal holidays, giving you even more opportunities to rest and connect outside of work.

HealthCorps, Inc. Is an Equal Opportunity Employer. HealthCorps provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics, and in compliance with all state and federal law requirements.

HealthCorps, Inc. Complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

HealthCorps, Inc. Reserves the right to conduct background investigations and/or reference checks on all its potential employees. Your job offer is contingent upon a clearance of a background investigation and/or reference check.

Note: HealthCorps reserves the right to assign additional duties, as needed. All HealthCorps employees are encouraged to be flexible and responsive to changes in scope of duties.

Why join Giga

  • The Team: A team of operators defining the future of AI infrastructure. We recruit A-players from the most innovative companies in the world, and they choose Giga because the work here means more.
  • The Moment: AI doesn't run without power, and that's us. Giga is the picks and shovels behind the AI revolution. This industry is about to explode, and you'll be in the room where it's already happening.

What Youâll Do

Youâll own the signature pipeline end to end: queuing documents, sending them out, and tracking them to completion. This is a highly autonomous role: youâll be given the outcome we need and trusted to enforce the process to get there, adapting as priorities shift.

Where youâll work

Responsibilities

  • Design and own a centralized legal intake process, replacing todayâs scattered mix of personal email, Slack channels and DMs, and texts with a single, clear front door for legal requests.

e.l.f. Beauty, Inc. stands with every eye, lip, face, paw and fin. Our deep commitment to clean, cruelty free beauty at an incredible value has fueled the success of our flagship brand e.l.f. Cosmetics since 2004 and driven our portfolio expansion. Today, our multi-brand portfolio includes e.l.f. Cosmetics, e.l.f. SKIN, Well People - clean beauty powered by plants, Naturium - high-performance, biocompatible, clinically-effective and accessible skin care, and our newest brand, rhode skin - developed by Hailey Rhode Bieber, a line of curated skincare essentials, formulated for a variety of skin types and needs with high performance ingredients, itâs a daily routine that nourishes your skin barrier over time

 

In our Fiscal year 26, we had net sales of $1.6 Billion and our business performance has been nothing short of extraordinary with 29 consecutive quarters of net sales growth. We are the #2 mass cosmetics brand in the US and are the fastest growing mass cosmetics brand among the top 5. Our total compensation philosophy offers every full-time new hire competitive pay and benefits, bonus eligibility (200% of target over the last seven fiscal years), equity, flexible time off, year-round half-day Fridays, and a hybrid 3 day in office, 2 day at home work environment. We believe the combination of our unique culture, total compensation, workplace flexibility and care for the team is unmatched across not just beauty but any industry. 

 

Visit our Career Page to learn more about our team: https://www.elfbeauty.com/work-with-us


The Manager, International Customer Supply Chain will play a key role in delivering an exceptional customer and retail partner experience across rhodeâs growing international business. This role will partner closely with Sales, Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Finance, Operations, international distributors and retail partners to ensure strong execution across order management, inventory flow, launch planning, and ongoing customer supply chain performance. This role will support multiple international markets and distribution partners, requiring strong coordination across regions and global supply chain processes.

This is a highly cross-functional role that requires strong analytical skills, clear communication, and the ability to operate in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where processes are still being built. The ideal candidate is proactive, solutions-oriented, and comfortable moving between day-to-day execution and longer-term process improvement.

A core focus of this role will be building strong relationships with key retail partners, understanding their supply chain requirements, supporting innovation and promotional planning, identifying and mitigating supply risks, and using customer data to improve in-stocks, fulfillment, and overall service levels.

\n


What You'll Do

  • Serve as a key point of contact between rhode and international distributors and retail customer operations teams, supporting day-to-day execution and market-specific supply chain needs

  •  Continually assess opportunities to improve customer supply chain, reduce operational costs, and drive volume through supply chain metrics

  • Develop a deep understanding of each international distributor and retail partnerâs distribution model, operational requirements, key metrics, and inventory planning needs

  • Strong analytical skills to produce qualitative/quantitative data (using Excel, PowerPoint, NetSuite, Tableau) that can be shared to drive business

  • Broad understanding of policies, processes and systems relating to retail distributor operations

  • Internal and external collaboration for alignment and identifying opportunities

  • Participate and influence assortment decisions aimed at optimizing sales and productivity by utilizing analytics, market research, consumer research, and customer intelligence

opportunities.title: Onboarding Specialist
opportunities.description:
INNERGY is transforming the woodworking industry with purpose built, cloud based ERP software designed exclusively for custom manufacturers. Our platform helps businesses operate smarter, faster, and more efficiently while seamlessly connecting design, production, and delivery for teams creating architectural millwork, cabinetry, and casework.

What truly sets INNERGY apart is our people. Founded in 2016, we are a globally distributed team of 200 plus professionals united by deep software expertise and a shared passion for solving meaningful, real world problems. We value collaboration, creativity, and ownership, and we are intentional about building not only powerful products, but also a culture where people feel supported, heard, and inspired to do their best work.

With strong momentum and the recent acquisition of Microvellum, a trusted leader in design to manufacturing solutions for the woodworking industry, INNERGY is entering an exciting new phase of growth. This combination expands our capabilities, deepens our industry impact, and accelerates our vision of delivering a truly connected, end to end platform for custom manufacturers.

As we scale thoughtfully and bring together top talent and new perspectives, this is a unique opportunity to join a company where your work will have visible impact, your ideas will help shape decisions, and your contributions will play a meaningful role in defining the future of a fast evolving product, team, and industry.

Job Description

In this role, you will guide clients through our structured onboarding process, ensuring they adopt INNERGY effectively and achieve measurable business value early in their journey.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Client Onboarding: Manage the onboarding process for new clients by setting clear expectations, defining milestones, and tracking progress against onboarding goals.
  • Education & Enablement: Support client education by integrating learning opportunities into onboarding and collaborating with the Content Creation team to prioritize and request the training resources clients need most.
  • Process Monitoring: Use data and progress tracking to monitor client health during onboarding, identifying and addressing potential challenges early.
  • Client Motivation: Keep clients engaged and motivated throughout onboarding, encouraging adoption of INNERGY processes and best practices.
  • Communication: Maintain clear, consistent communication with clients, providing regular updates and documenting all interactions for cross-team visibility.
  • Problem Solving: Identify and address challenges such as limited client engagement or resistance to change. Develop strategies to overcome these obstacles and keep onboarding on track.
  • Feedback Loop: Gather client feedback throughout onboarding and share insights to help refine onboarding strategies and influence future training content priorities.

Qualifications

  • Experience in onboarding, client success, or related roles, preferably within Microvellum architectural millwork industry, or manufacturing.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to analyze data and use insights to manage progress and risks.
  • Skilled at motivating and guiding clients toward successful outcomes.
  • Experience collaborating with content or training teams to prioritize and influence resource development.
  • Problem-solving mindset with adaptability to client needs and challenges.
  • Travel up to 10%

Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Accessibility & Work Environment

INNERGY is committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible workplace. We support reasonable adjustments for individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable laws. If you require any accommodations during the recruitment process or in your role, please let us know.

This role is primarily computer-based and may involve extended periods of screen time and frequent communication through digital tools. Work may be performed remotely or in an office setting, depending on the role and location. We prioritize employee wellbeing, flexibility, and a safe, supportive work environment across all regions.

Equal Opportunity Employer

INNERGY is an Equal Opportunity Employer that values diversity at every level of the organization. We are committed to creating a workplace free from discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

Location Eligibility Notice

This is a U.S.-based remote role. Due to current regulatory requirements, we are only able to consider candidates residing in certain U.S. states.

Eligible states include, but are not limited to: Texas, Florida, Missouri, Arizona, Indiana, North Carolina, and Wisconsin.

At this time, candidates located in California, Colorado, New York, Illinois, Washington, or other states with active pay transparency requirements are not eligible for consideration.

opportunities.title: Animal Cruelty Case Specialist
opportunities.description:
Description

Term of Employment: Full-Time, Exempt

Reports To: Criminal Justice Program Managing Attorney

Union: Bargaining Unit Position, Nonprofit Professional Employees Union (NPEU)

Location: Remote (U.S. Based)

Who We Are

The Animal Legal Defense Fundâs mission is to protect the lives and advance the interests of animals through the legal system. The Animal Legal Defense Fund accomplishes this mission by filing high-impact lawsuits to protect animals from harm, providing free legal assistance and training to prosecutors to assure that animal abusers are held accountable for their crimes, supporting tough animal protection legislation and fighting legislation harmful to animals, gathering data about and advocating for effective regulation of animal exploitative industries and providing resources and opportunities to law students and professionals to advance the emerging field of animal law.

Role Description

The Criminal Justice Program (CJP) Animal Cruelty Case Specialist position furthers the mission of the Animal Legal Defense Fund (ALDF) to protect the lives and advance the interests of animals through the legal system, by providing prosecutors, law enforcement, animal control, veterinarians, and animal rescues with essential operational and forensic support on criminal animal cruelty cases and encouraging the investigation and prosecution of animal crimes to ensure justice for animal victims. The CJP Animal Cruelty Case Specialist triages all incoming reports of animal cruelty and maintains the active case database. The Animal Cruelty Case Specialist applies their experience and expertise to in-depth case-related research and to the training of key stakeholders. This position acts as a liaison across ALDFâs programs to disseminate approved case response information in a timely and responsible manner. The Animal Cruelty Case Specialist is accountable for the day-to-day management of their assigned cases and projects.

How You Will Make a Difference

Case Support

  • Receive reports of animal cruelty and requests for case assistance from professional stakeholders, the Administrative Manager, and other sources. Provide initial responses and triage via phone or email.
  • Exercise discretion in analyzing and recommending which cases CJP chooses to pursue, including communicating efficiently with complainants and advocates by phone and email; gathering relevant facts (through eyewitness accounts, media reports, and other sources as needed) for potential criminal cruelty cases; and identifying, after thorough independent analysis, those cases warranting further investigation and/or veterinary forensics.
  • Generate and categorize cases, and work with Managing Attorneys to assign cases to CJP staff according to department protocols. Ensure that complete and accurate case information is relayed in a timely fashion to the appropriate team members.
  • Input and access information using automated systems, make entries into automated record files, seek to maximize use of automated systems available to CJP to further efficiency and accuracy in case response and record keeping.
  • Maintain and organize all case-related records and documentation in a timely, logical, and confidential manner. Ensure that electronic logs of all legal cases are accurate and current. Review case notes to maintain consistent and timely response in all cases.
  • Conduct internet research on potential/active cases (i.e. Facebook, social media, news sources, and company websites). Provide basic assistance in research projects, special reports, and case information gathering. Prepare materials for meetings, court proceedings, and case discovery.
  • Follow up with professional stakeholders on case outcomes/resolutions where possible. Create and maintain a system for tracking date and time of upcoming court proceedings related to CJP-assisted cases.
  • Manage CJP grant processing for expert witnesses, forensic testing, and costs of care in criminal cases, coordinating with internal and external individuals as needed.
  • Inform and assist law enforcement, animal control, veterinarians, and animal rescues on animal cruelty case investigations and case strategies, including reviewing and advising on interview tactics, department policies and procedures, veterinary exams and reports, protective custody foster care programs and related agreements, and large-scale animal rescue implementation.
  • Participate in deployment to crime scenes and rescues as needed, exercising discretion in both the decision to travel on-site and the orchestration of such activities.
  • Assist with hands-on scene processing for animal cruelty cases, including identifying, collecting and packaging evidence; assisting with logistics and operational expertise; and assisting with other aspects of search and seizure operations and animal rescue support.
  • Provide support as requested to CJP Case Response Unit.

External Relationship Building and Outreach

  • Build strategic relationships with prosecutors, law enforcement, animal control, veterinarians, and animal rescues to facilitate agency assistance in forensics, crime scene processing, and veterinary medicine.
  • Schedule and conduct outreach and training presentations for various disciplines, including but not limited to law enforcement agencies, veterinarians, prosecutors, animal shelters and rescues, and social service agencies.

Internal Relationship Building

  • Proactively maintain intradepartmental relationships and act as a liaison to other programs.
  • Create and maintain system for sharing information about CJP case work and outcomes across departments and facilitate the sharing of information approved for public-facing materials.
  • Provide in-house expertise for staff on questions concerning Criminal Justice Program cases, animal cruelty cases in general, criminal investigation, veterinary forensics, animal rescue and sheltering.

Please note, this job description is not intended to be a comprehensive list of all duties and responsibilities of the position, which are subject to change in order to best advance ALDFâs strategic objectives and mission.

Requirements

We Are Looking for Candidates With:

  • A bachelorâs degree in a related field desired; or 5 years equivalent work experience accepted in lieu of.
  • At least 3 years of experience in enforcement fieldwork operations, animal cruelty response, dispatch, and/or criminal case management.
  • Demonstrated veterinary forensics or animal cruelty enforcement expertise, including but not limited to, retaining related certifications in the field (such as Certificate in Veterinary Forensics, NACA certifications, FEMA certification, Property and Evidence Certifications, Police or Humane Officer certification).
  • The ability to handle sensitive and confidential information and materials according to the highest standards of confidentiality, chain of custody, and ethical conduct and exercise discretion in the use of related materials and information.
  • Excellent organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to meet deadlines.
  • Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate effectively with colleagues, organizational members and supporters, members of the public, and others. A positive attitude, ability to work cooperatively with others, and ability to function well in a team-oriented work environment.
  • Comfort speaking in public to audiences of various sizes and demographics.
  • The ability to maintain composure and lead others in times of heightened urgency or stress.
  • An understanding of and full commitment to the vision, mission, and core values of the Animal Legal Defense Fund.
  • The ability to travel frequently to conferences, trainings, meetings, and other events as required; estimated 5-7 events per year.

We Offer Competitive Compensation With Excellent Benefits, Including

  • Starting annual salary of $71,509 for most geographic locations.
  • For candidates located within 25 miles of Washington D.C., Cotati, CA, and Los Angeles, starting pay is $75,273.
  • For candidates located within 25 miles of New York City and San Francisco, starting pay is $79,036.

To ensure salary equity, we do not negotiate salary outside of the published starting rate. Rate is determined by role, using set geographical factors.

  • Comprehensive health care, dental, life and vision benefits (100% employer paid); Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Dependent Care Account (DCA) are also available
  • 192 hours of PTO
  • 19 paid holidays
  • 1-month paid sabbatical after 5 years of continuous employment
  • 16 weeks paid parental leave
  • 401k plan with a maximum 5% employer contribution match after one year of employment
  • Alternative work schedules (at managerâs discretion)
  • One-time remote work allowance of $750
  • Annual professional development reimbursement of up to $1,000.

Maintaining a healthy work/life balance is a core value for the Animal Legal Defense Fund.

Additional Information

This role is included in a collective bargaining unit that is represented by the Nonprofit Professional Employees Union (NPEU). Certain terms and conditions of your employment, including wages and benefits, have been negotiated with the Union and are included in a collective bargaining agreement between ALDF and the Union.

This is a U.S. based position. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire.

The Animal Legal Defense Fund (ALDF) is an equal opportunity employer and committed to providing an employment environment which is welcoming of persons from diverse backgrounds and free from unlawful discrimination and harassment, and in which all legal rights of our employees are recognized and protected. ALDF conducts all internal and external operations, programs, and employment-related decision making (including hiring decisions) without regard to actual or perceived race, ancestry, color, religion, national origin, citizenship, immigration status, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), gender identity or expression, political affiliation, disability or medical condition (including physical, intellectual, or psychiatric), sexual orientation, marital status, military or veteran status, genetic information, age, or other protected category, and in compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local anti-discrimination and anti-harassment laws.

Consistent with the organizationâs mission, our offices and events are free of animal products and byproducts.

opportunities.description:
Benefits:

  • Health insurance
  • Opportunity for advancement
  • Paid time off
  • Vision insurance
  • Wellness resources
  • Employee discounts


About UFC GYM

UFC GYM is the first major brand extension of UFC, the world's premier mixed martial arts organization. As the pioneer of MMA-inspired fitness, UFC GYM offers members access to world-class training programs, group fitness classes, personal and small-group training, and youth programming across corporate and franchise locations worldwide. Our brand lives at the intersection of combat sports, fitness, and community and our marketing team brings that energy to life every day.

Position Overview

UFC GYM is seeking a Junior Designer to join our in-house marketing team. Reporting to the Lead Designer, this role supports the creative execution of brand campaigns, member acquisition initiatives, new club openings, and field marketing programs across our corporate and franchise network. This is a hands-on production and design role â ideal for a creative who thrives in a fast-paced environment, takes direction well, and is excited to grow within a globally recognized fitness brand.

Key Responsibilities

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Design & Production

  • Create original graphic designs supporting company initiatives, including promotions, member acquisition campaigns, events, partnerships, and internal communications
  • Take approved concepts and designs from the Lead Designer and scale a single design across multiple formats, sizes, and channels (digital display, social, email, in-club signage, print collateral)
  • Ensure all creative output adheres to UFC GYM brand standards, templates, and style guidelines
  • Prepare print-ready and web-optimized files with accurate specs, bleeds, and color profiles


New Club Openings & Remodels

  • Develop and execute gym graphics plans for new club openings and remodels, including wall graphics, wayfinding, window clings, and environmental branding
  • Coordinate with vendors, printers, and field teams to ensure accurate production and installation of location graphics


Asset Management

  • Upload, organize, and maintain creative assets within the company's asset management platform, ensuring files are current, properly named, and accessible to corporate and franchise stakeholders
  • Support the marketing team in fulfilling creative asset requests from franchise locations and field teams


Team Support

  • Participate in creative briefings, provide production timelines, and manage multiple concurrent projects against deadlines
  • Support photo and video needs for events, club openings, and content capture as needed


Required Qualifications

  • 1â3 years of graphic design experience (agency, in-house, or strong portfolio of freelance/academic work)
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud (CC)
  • Proficiency in Canva and Figma
  • Experience working with Dropbox or similar cloud-based file management systems
  • Strong understanding of design fundamentals: typography, layout, hierarchy, and color
  • Ability to work within an established brand system and follow creative direction
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple projects and shifting priorities
  • Portfolio required with application


Preferred Qualifications

  • Photography, videography, and video editing skills (Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut or equivalent) â highly preferred
  • Experience with large-format print production and environmental graphics
  • Familiarity with fitness, sports, or lifestyle brands
  • Experience supporting multi-location or franchise organizations
  • Motion graphics or animation experience


Benefits

  • Full-time position with benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Complimentary UFC GYM membership
  • Paid time off and holidays
  • Growth opportunity within a global fitness brand


We empower the fighting spirit in you!

This is a remote position.

This franchise is independently owned and operated by a franchisee. Your application will go directly to the franchisee, and all hiring decisions will be made by the management of this franchisee. All inquiries about employment at this franchisee should be made directly to the franchise location, and not to UFC Gym.
